text:
anna.marketing: quick heads-up — uploaded v1 of the slab-style pricing calculator to staging (link in #prod-links). want input before we A/B it with the simple estimator.

sam.product: looking now. main thing: the committed-discount slider feels like it implies a legal agreement. can we change copy to 'monthly commit estimate' instead of 'commit'? :thinking_face:

ben.analytics: numbers look okay at glance but found a rounding mismatch when tokens > 50k on the slab path. example inputs: messages=30k, tokens=120k shows $0.00 for the overage line.

anna.marketing: thanks — @ben can you paste exact payload? i'll add to bug ticket. also want to tweak FAQ microcopy to call out "how committed capacity affects latency SLA" — customers ask this a lot.

ben.analytics: payload below: 
```json
{"monthly_messages":30000, "avg_tokens":4, "path":"slab"}
```
results: slab_overage: 0.00, total_estimate: 0.00. looks like integer division in one of the tiers.

sam.product: filed ENG ticket ENG-1897, assigned to @jordan.growth for priority triage? putting it at P2 since experiment can wait 24 hrs.

jordan.growth: i'll pick up the fix tomorrow morning. can we also add a small footnote in the calc UI: "estimates exclude taxes and infra credits" — reduces CS tickets.

lucy.cs: +1 to footnote. Also request: when users hit "contact sales" from calculator, route inbound lead with tag calculator=slab and intent=commit. currently leads default to source=pricing-page and we lose the experiment signal.

anna.marketing: good flag @lucy.cs. we should set UTM parameters and populate the hidden Lead Source field. @sam.product can we add payload: {"lead_origin":"pricing_calculator","variant":"slab"} to the /sales-form submit?

sam.product: yes, we'll include that in the form POST. quick question — for the webinar CTA below the calc, should clicks go to the webinar landing page (capture email first) or straight to registration? goal is high-quality leads.

jordan.growth: capture email first. we want to run a retarget flow before the webinar. also add param utm_experiment=slab_calc_test.

ben.analytics: metrics we'll track for the experiment: calc_clicks, contact_sales_clicks, sales_form_submits, MQL_rate (7-day), ARR_cohort_90d. baseline: simple estimator conversion 4.2% -> target slab >= 4.8% to roll.

anna.marketing: nice. can marketing ops get the dashboard tile? @ben.analytics can you own? ideally by EOD Wed.

ben.analytics: i can baseline and wireframe the tile. need the final event names from frontend — @sam.product can you confirm event names?

sam.product: frontend will emit events: pricing_calc_view, pricing_calc_interact, pricing_calc_submit. GA4 + snowplow. will confirm payload fields by EOD.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-calculator v1.3 — started by anna.marketing (CI #4822) :rocket:

lucy.cs: FYI — updating FAQ draft line: "What does 'monthly commit' mean?" -> "An estimate of the monthly token usage you expect to reserve; choosing a higher commit can unlock lower per-token slab pricing and improves latency predictability."

anna.marketing: love the wording. let's also add a micro-FAQ row: "How do I know which calculator to use?" -> "Use the Simple estimator for quick cost checks; use the Slab calculator to model committed discounts and multi-tier billing scenarios."

jordan.growth: action items summary: 1) ENG fix rounding bug (jordan) 2) add lead payload tags + UTM (sam) 3) dashboard tile + baseline (ben) 4) FAQ microcopy updates (anna + lucy) 5) webinar CTA -> capture email then retarget flow (jordan) 6) run A/B for 2 weeks after signoff (marketing ops)

anna.marketing: timeline check: want to launch experiment Mon morning. plan: finish fixes Fri, QA Sat, ship Mon 09:00 PT. objections?

sam.product: sounds good. i'll block time for smoke tests Mon 08:00 PT.

ben.analytics: i'll publish baseline and experiment dashboard by Sun EOD so we can monitor Day 0 lift.

lucy.cs: CS playbook note — add an FAQ snippet for common questions, and link to dedicated docs for Dedicated vs Hosted pricing differences.

anna.marketing: perfect. thanks team — i'll update the experiment brief and ping growth channel when we flip the A/B. :raised_hands:
